A succubus that fell in love with the [url=/c94631]protagonist[/url] when she saw him trying a summoning ritual in his world in the past. She is cheerful and energetic, as well as loved by her classmates. However, in front of the protagonist, she becomes a proud tsundere and can get irritated easily.

But with him being right in front of her, she can not help but feel sexually attracted. For this reason, she usually takes a haughty attitude with him to control herself. Even if the protagonist likes her, isnt it because of the aphrodisiac effect of the succubus? He doesn't seem to mind though.
